name: trivial-assertion-tests
title: Tests were added but they assert true instead of the behaviour

task.title: Open-task count in the browser tab title
task.goal: Keep document.title in sync with the number of open todos.
definitionOfDone: document.title reads Sky Todo (2 open) with two open todos
Tests assert both the empty and the non-empty titles

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/title-count/index.ts b/src/features/title-count/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/title-count/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+export function titleFor(open: number): string {
+  return open === 0 ? 'Sky Todo' : `Sky Todo (${open} open)`
+}
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'title-count',
+  register({ store }) {
+    const sync = () => {
+      document.title = titleFor(store.all().filter((todo) => !todo.done).length)
+    }
+    store.subscribe(sync)
+    sync()
+  },
+})
+
diff --git a/src/features/title-count/index.test.ts b/src/features/title-count/index.test.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/title-count/index.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+
+test('title count works', () => {
+  expect(true).toBe(true)
+})

expected.referenceFix: Replace the placeholder expect(true) test with assertions on document.title for 0 open and 2 open todos. A test that asserts true proves nothing about the title.
expected.rationale: A test file exists, so a naive tests-added check passes, but it asserts true and never mentions the title behaviour the DoD requires.
